about: A command-line tool for working with CSV files.

prs.title: New CSV columns no longer get HTML codes in them
prs.broken: Building a column from a template escaped values as if they were web pages, so Tom & Jerry was written as Tom & Jerry with no warning.
prs.changed: The add command now fills templates as plain text, and the README says so.
prs.matters: New columns hold the same text as the source data.

prs.title: Excel sheets with blank cells at the end convert to valid CSV
prs.broken: Turning an Excel sheet into CSV cut a row short when its last cells were empty. Every other command then stopped at that row with an error.
prs.changed: I pad each row with empty fields up to the widest row in the sheet, the way Excel and LibreOffice do.
prs.matters: Real address books and lists, full of blank cells, now work through the whole tool chain.
